0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFGLASSESEXCHANGE_00850_TALK_000_000
0.description: Greetings. I'm conducting a recall of spectacles formerly classified as headgear. I shall be happy to exchange any such items in your possession for a new, more convenient model.
0.translation_description: Salve. Mi occupo del ritiro degli occhiali un tempo classificati come copricapo. Sarò felice di sostituire quelli che possiedi con un modello nuovo e più pratico.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFGLASSESEXCHANGE_00850_A1_000_001
2.translation_description: Scambia gli occhiali (convertili in accessori viso).

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFGLASSESEXCHANGE_00850_SYSTEM_000_001
4.description: Spectacles registered as fashion accessories will be exchanged for the equivalent facewear item.
4.translation_description: Gli occhiali registrati come accessori di moda verranno sostituiti dal corrispondente accessorio viso.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFGLASSESEXCHANGE_00850_TALK_000_002
5.description: Ah. It would seem you don't have any spectacles of the sort I'm recalling. If you happen to obtain a pair, please do bring them to me.
5.translation_description: Ah. A quanto pare, non possiedi occhiali del tipo che sto ritirando. Se dovessi trovarne un paio, portameli pure.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFGLASSESEXCHANGE_00850_TALK_000_003
6.description: Ah. It would seem you have already exchanged all your spectacles. Thank you for your cooperation.
6.translation_description: Ah. A quanto pare, hai già scambiato tutti i tuoi occhiali. Grazie per la collaborazione.
